seoTitle: Website Audit for Painters & Decorators in London — Free Health Check
metaDescription: Free AI website audit for London painters and decorators. Find out why your site isn't winning more quote requests in one of the UK's most competitive markets.
intro: London's decorating market is dense and image-driven — homeowners scroll through several portfolios on their phone before picking up the phone, and the businesses that win are the ones whose galleries load instantly and whose service area is crystal clear across dozens of boroughs.
painPoints: Competing against a high volume of London decorators, where a slow-loading portfolio loses the comparison before your work is even seen
No borough-specific pages (e.g. Hackney, Wandsworth, Islington) despite London's local searches increasingly being borough-specific
Testimonials and before/after photos not optimised for the fast, comparison-heavy browsing typical of London homeowners researching multiple quotes at once
Inconsistent quoting process across the site, adding friction in a market where competitors are often just one more tab away

faq.question: How many London decorators are typically competing for the same search?
faq.answer: Dozens in most boroughs — which is why fast page load, borough-specific content, and instantly visible trust signals (reviews, before/after photos) matter more in London than in less competitive markets.

faq.question: Should I have a page for each London borough I cover?
faq.answer: Yes, if you genuinely serve multiple boroughs — dedicated pages let you rank for borough-specific searches (e.g. "decorator in Clapham") that a single London-wide page can't compete for as effectively.

faq.question: What converts best on a London decorator's website?
faq.answer: Fast-loading, genuine before-and-after photos paired with visible reviews and a one-step quote request — London homeowners are comparing several sites at once, so friction anywhere in that path loses the enquiry.
